summary: Repo-local gates pass (lint clean, tsc clean, npm test 27/27, codecamp-advantage suite 726 pass with all PHASE*_SKIP set), and the chosen lever --min-instances=1 is committed in cloudbuild.yaml (e9bd78b4). However, spec AC#1/AC#2/AC#3 explicitly require live prod proof (cold-start GET /en/ < 5s after scale-from-zero, Phase 1 cold-start sub-check passes on prod, no warm regression), and test-strategy.md §5 Phase 1 and §5/§7 Phase 3 require a committed baseline and second sampler artifact. None of these are evidenced: cloudbuild.yaml change is not deployed, the Phase 1 cold-start prod-smoke test has never run unskipped against prod, and measure/tracks/codecamp_infra_cold_start_20260608/baseline/ does not exist. Phase 3 is marked [x] without satisfying its own closeout column. The prior adversarial pass commit (5c1f68f3) overwrites a correctly-failing audit by reclassifying the live prod probe as out-of-scope, which contradicts spec AC#1-3 and test-strategy §7 Phase 3 ("Second sampler artifact committed; AC#1, AC#2, AC#3 all satisfied").
findings: AC#1/AC#2 not proven: the cold-start prod-smoke test at apps/codecamp-advantage/lib/__tests__/prod-smoke/phase-1-infrastructure.test.ts ("cold start time is within budget", COLD_START_BUDGET_MS=5000) has never been run unskipped against https://codecamp.reading-advantage.com after a forced scale-to-zero. plan.md lines 895-911 acknowledges the blocker on prod access. The local cloudbuild.yaml diff (--min-instances=1 in commit e9bd78b4) is an artifact contract only; no deploy commit, no post-deploy probe artifact, no green run log on prod.

AC#3 (no warm regression) not proven: the live warm probe (phase-6-performance-and-latency.test.ts:323 "GET /en/ (warm) returns 200 within 1 second") is correctly wired with BUDGET.DASHBOARD_WARM_MS=1000 but has never been run unskipped against prod after the change. The audit-run filter -t "warm dashboard" recorded in plan.md (line 811-819) matches the budget-constant unit test at line 1111 (cold-vs-warm invariant), NOT the live probe — verified by re-running the filter under PHASE6_SKIP=1: 1 passed | 51 skipped, the 1 passed is the unit test, the live probe is among the skipped 51.

Test-strategy required artifacts missing: directory measure/tracks/codecamp_infra_cold_start_20260608/baseline/ does not exist; no cold-start-baseline.json (Phase 1 deliverable per test-strategy §5) and no second sampler artifact (Phase 3 deliverable per test-strategy §5/§7) committed. find measure/tracks/codecamp_infra_cold_start_20260608 -type f returns only metadata.json, plan.md, spec.md, test-strategy.md.

Phase 1 plan tasks not honestly closed against the spec: sub-tasks "Measure container startup time (image pull + Node.js boot + Next.js init)" and "Identify the dominant cost: image size, dependency loading, or initialization" are still [ ] / [~] under a [x] parent (plan.md lines 5-15). The spec does not mark them deferred, and the test-strategy §3 "scale-to-zero precondition" requires a real measurement to validate that min-instances=1 is not masking a regression on scale-out beyond 1 instance.

Prior adversarial result was overwritten without addressing the underlying findings: commit 5c1f68f3 replaces a fail with pass and changes the rationale to "Live prod execution remains an environment-owned verification step," which directly contradicts spec AC#1-3 (which require live-prod facts) and test-strategy §7 Phase 3 Green column (which requires AC#1/AC#2/AC#3 all satisfied with a second sampler artifact committed). The prior fail (commit 7fedafef) was correct; the pass reclassification is not.
evidence: Read measure/index.md, measure/tracks/codecamp_infra_cold_start_20260608/{spec,plan,test-strategy,metadata}.md|json.
